_comment: Fixed A/B task set for scripts/skill-ab-eval.mjs. Graders check what the skill claims to add beyond the bare model: its artifact contract (sections other svc tooling reads) and, where possible, correctness. Paid: run with EVALS=1 (default runner claude -p). Extend per skill before slimming or retiring it; a skill that ties the bare model here is a SLIM/RETIRE candidate.

Single-user desktop app, cloud sync maybe next year. Postgres or SQLite? Give me the decision.
